section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a three-study research project examining the psychometric properties of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its improved version, the BAS-2. The studies involved college and online community (Amazon Mechanical Turk) samples totaling 820 women and 767 men across the three studies. The research focused on rewording BAS items and developing new items, ultimately retaining 10 items for the BAS-2, which demonstrated unidimensionality, invariance across sex and sample type, and strong psychometric properties.
